I saved a draft mail to Tobias Rendle (trendle@pemberline.com) with the subject "Tansley Parcel proposed 2027 per-seat rate" and replied to June in her DM to confirm.

The draft gives the proposed 2027 rate of $1,313 a seat. It says the figure came from Pree Sundaram, who owns the account, and that June approved sharing it. Tobias's address is on pemberline.com, so this internal draft didn't need Ruth Calloway's sign-off.

Nothing has been sent; someone still has to review the draft and send it. On the 14th I told June the draft would go in Pree's mailbox, but the drafting tool saved it in mine instead. Pree may need it moved or recreated in her mailbox if she's going to send it herself.
